ist / note_update / note_delete tools.
# dsh-sticky-notes

A tiled sticky-note board in the DeepSeek Harness sidebar, plus four tools so the
assistant works th

y-note board in the DeepSeek Harness sidebar, plus four tools so the
assistant works the same notes.

- **Sidebar entry** — a note glyph in the left rail. Clicking it opens the board in
the main column.

- **Tiled board** — one card per note. The density control pins the grid to 2 / 3 / 4
/ 5 per row,

or lets it fill the width automatically (the choice is remembered).
- **Colours** — seven accents (p

lain, amber, rose, mint, sky, violet, slate). A card,
its border and its dot share one accent; the t

oolbar filters by colour.
- **Pin** — pinned notes stay on top and carry a small pin mark.
- **Trash

** — deleting moves a note to the trash tab, where it can be restored,
deleted for good, or emptied

all at once. The toast carries an undo.
- **Editor** — click a card for a dialog with title, body, c

olour swatches, pin toggle,
character count, copy, duplicate, archive/restore and permanent delete.

Typing saves
itself ~0.55 s after the last keystroke.
- **Search, sort, export** — text search over

title and body, sort by recently updated /
created / title, and one-click Markdown export of the who

le board.
- **Shortcuts** — `Ctrl/Cmd+N` new note, `Ctrl/Cmd+F` focus search, `Escape` close.
- **Du

rable storage** — notes live in the plugin's `sticky_notes` storage domain under
`$DSH_HOME/storages

`, not in `localStorage`, so they survive a port change, a browser
switch and a desktop-app restart.

- **Assistant tools** — `note_create`, `note_list`, `note_update`, `note_delete`. Ask
“记一条：明天 10 点交
周报，放琥珀色” and the card appears on the board.
## Install
[代码示例省略，未执行]

The bundle patch inserts one row (`sticky-notes`); the `dsh.client` block makes the web app
load `li

b/client.js` as the browser half. A directory install needs no restart of the app —
the host reloads
the row — but an already-open tab only picks up the bundle on its next load.
[代码示例省略，未执行]
## Tools
| Tool | Parameters | What it does |
| `note_create` | `body`, `title?`, `color?`, `pinned?` | Create a note; the first body line becomes

the title when omitted |
| `note_list` | `query?`, `color?`, `pinned?`, `includeArchived?`, `sort?`

| List notes with the board's filters; the trash is hidden unless asked for |
| `note_update` | `id
`, `title?`, `body?`, `color?`, `pinned?`, `archived?` | Patch one note; `archived: false` restores

it |
| `note_delete` | `id`, `permanent?` | Move to the trash, or erase when `permanent: true` |
All four answer with one text block. Ids look like `note-<base36 time>-<random>`.
## HTTP surface

The board talks to one authenticated route, mounted under `/api` so the connection
service applies i
ts Host/Origin fence and browser-session check first:
[代码示例省略，未执行]

The route path is published into the served page as
`globalThis.__DSH_STICKY_NOTES_CONFIG__ = { rout
ePath }`, so the browser half never hard-codes it.
## Layout
[代码示例省略，未执行]
## Limits

- One body is capped at 20,000 characters, a title at 200; longer text is truncated, not refused.
-

No folders, tags or cross-device sync beyond the Host that owns the storage domain.
- Card order is
by pin and then the chosen sort key; there is no drag-to-reorder.
## Tests
[代码示例省略，未执行]

`notes.test.js` covers the pure shaping, colour, pin, trash and ordering rules,
`route.test.js` ever

y HTTP branch, `client.test.js` the bundle's registrations and its
filter/sort copy, and `adapter.te

st.js` mounts the real `lib/` against stub Harness
packages to prove `apply()` wires the domain, rou
te, tools and disposal together.
A real browser pass needs a web host: boot one against an isolated profile, then drive it.
[代码示例省略，未执行]

It creates a coloured pinned note through the UI, switches the grid to three per row,
searches, arch

ives and restores through the trash, and fails unless colour, pin and
content survive a reload. Evid
ence from the shipped run is in `VERIFY.md`.
